# tools

Small command-line tools of the seed repository, one file each under `tools/`.

- `greet.mjs` prints `hello` and exits 0.
- `answer.mjs` prints `42` and exits 0.
- `bye.mjs` prints `bye` and exits 0.
- `count.mjs` prints `3` and exits 0.
- `echo.mjs` prints `echo` and exits 0.
- `six.mjs` prints `6` and exits 0.
